quote: Thorold Gosset enumerated the list of nonprismatic semiregular convex polytopes with regular facets (convex regular 4-polytopes) in his publication On the Regular and Semi-Regular Figures in Space of n Dimensions.
note: Gosset's 1900 paper 'On the Regular and Semi-Regular Figures in Space of n Dimensions' represents the first systematic attempt to classify and enumerate uniform polytopes in higher dimensions, including 5-dimensional space. While his enumeration was incomplete by modern standards, this work established the classification problem itself.
